rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s broad request (“cancel or return everything not associated with gaming, except keyboard and mouse”). Instead, they acted on a single item return (item_id 5796612084 from order #W7387996) without showing any clarification of which items are gaming-related, without covering all relevant orders, and without considering cancellations for undelivered items. Policy breaches are evident: (1) no clear authentication beyond an email lookup, (2) a write action (return) was performed without explicit user confirmation, and (3) incomplete fulfillment of the user’s scope and preferences. While PayPal was used (matching the stated preference), the lack of confirmation and incomplete handling means the request was not completed in line with policy.
